title: Existing-Home Sales (NAR) — the other half of the 2026-12-09 GDPNow vintage, on FOMC decision day
source: EST: the Atlanta Fed's GDPNowcastDataReleaseDates.xlsx PostedUpdates sheet, fetched direct 2026-09-06 at /-/media/Project/Atlanta/FRBA/Documents/cqer/researchcq/gdpnow/, whose 2026-12-09 10:00 row reads "Wholesale trade, Existing-home sales". ONE source only: NAR's own 2026 release schedule was sought the same day at nar.realtor/newsroom/release-schedule (HTTP 404) and on the existing-home-sales statistics page (HTTP 200, no 2026 December date anywhere in the text), so the date rests on the Atlanta Fed's incorporation schedule rather than on the publisher's calendar. Corroborated only by pattern: across 140 GDPNow vintages naming an existing-home-sales release, every 2025 instance falls on day 18-26 of the month while every 2026 instance falls on day 9-14 (2026-01-14, 02-12, 03-10, 04-13, 05-11, 06-09, 07-09), so a December 9 slot is consistent with the current regime and inconsistent with the old one. Filed estimate on both counts — single-source and discovered in-sweep. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the wholesale-trade-2026-12-09 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06). Why it earns its own row rather than a line in that ledger: it is the measured reason that print's nowcast reading is harder to attribute than its 12-08 neighbour's. GDPNow vintages that carry Monthly Wholesale Trade ALONE (44 of 78, the sheet's free-text `Data releases` column reading exactly "Wholesale trade", case-insensitively) move the change-in-inventory-investment contribution a median 0.0485pp with 88.6% under 0.10pp; vintages sharing the day with at least one other release (34) move it 0.0854pp with only 61.8% under 0.10pp — permutation p=0.045. The 2026-12-09 vintage is in the shared class, and the pairing is rare: only 2 of 78 wholesale vintages in the 2014-2026 archive name a home-sales release at all. Two further readings belong with it. It is a NAR release, not a federal one, so unlike every Census entry in this corridor it is immune to the 2026-12-11 funding cliff — which makes it the control observation if that cliff ever bites. And it lands 10:00 a.m. ET on FOMC decision day, inside the hour that makes only 26.3% of SPY's session range on decision days against 40.2% baseline (23 decision days in 723 hourly sessions, measured 2026-09-06), so its own tape signature is unreadable for the same reason the wholesale print's is. Impact LOW and symbols empty: no house playbook is macro-keyed and no instrument attaches; a homebuilder-keyed playbook would change that and does not exist today. Proposed as an estimate on a single source; nothing here licenses an entry, and its own initial research should re-verify the date against NAR before anything is built on it.
